title: Vignette 2026-10-30: meaning must be available; a repository specifies how it is seen; packages define the editors and renderers

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Owner, 2026-10-30: "we want to make sure that meaning is available. A human using srs must be able to have a view that makes sense. We may find that there is no real way to make a generic repo readable for everyone, but we should be able to get a sense of what;s inside it. A repo should probably be able to specify a default way to be seen. Packages will define what editors/ renderers are available. This is part of our drive to make an initial public use case that people can understand and see the value of"
